compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
On `origin/main` at `25d1d683e55a`, `make worktree name=comment-remediation-3e32` selected `/opt/homebrew/bin/uv` 0.12.9 while `pyproject.toml` requires 0.12.7. `uv venv` correctly refused the mismatch, but the Makefile catch-all handler reported that Python 3.12 was unavailable and advised `uv python install 3.12`. Running the same target with the existing 0.12.7 binary created a Python 3.12.13 venv, proving that diagnosis false.

The exact uv pin and its refusal are intentional. This bug is the misleading classification of every `uv venv` failure as a missing interpreter. It is distinct from `princely-courageous-milksnake`, which repairs the machine-local updater uv selection.

## Approach
Keep fail-fast provisioning. Add a preflight that compares the selected uv executable/version with the repository exact required version before `uv venv`, and emit a mismatch-specific diagnostic naming the executable, actual version, and required version. Preserve the existing interpreter-unavailable diagnostic for a compatible uv whose venv operation fails.

Extend the real-Makefile subprocess tests with controlled uv stubs for both failure classes. The subprocess sandbox must copy `pyproject.toml` as well as the Makefile and `.github/python-version.txt`, so the new preflight reads the same `[tool.uv].required-version` source in tests that production `make venv` reads.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A selected uv version that violates `[tool.uv].required-version` fails before provisioning and names the selected path, actual version, and required version.
- [x] The mismatch path does not claim Python is unavailable or advise installing the already-available pinned interpreter.
- [x] A compatible uv whose `uv venv --python <pin>` fails still reports the pinned-interpreter provisioning failure.
- [x] `make worktree` continues to propagate either provisioning failure without printing its success message.
- [x] Focused Makefile worktree/python-pin tests, lint, and typecheck pass.

## Completion evidence

Gerrit change 2740 merged as 769392cacaf0c3c24d2dbdb5490b199af8102b90. Local `make verify` passed, and Gerrit CI run 34088035609 passed. RED/GREEN oracle: `tests/unit/test_worktree_python_pin.py::test_make_venv_reports_uv_version_mismatch_before_python_hint` failed before the Makefile preflight and passed after it.

file_impact.reason: Classify selected uv version mismatch separately from interpreter provisioning failure.
Drive the real Makefile with uv stubs covering incompatible-version and interpreter-unavailable diagnostics.
